title: DIVIDE ( 5, BLANK, 9 ) is 9: the alternate result also replaces a BLANK denominator

source.quote: When an alternate result is passed in, it's returned instead of BLANK
source.supports: the alternate result replaces the BLANK returned for a zero or BLANK denominator

derivation: The denominator is BLANK, which without a third argument gives BLANK. The alternate result 9 is returned instead.
notes: The column's type is not asserted, as in divide-function-alternate-result.
